Version: v1.0.0-alpha-r2
A Minecraft mod made with DID/OSDD systems in mind. • Website • Support Discord

> [!IMPORTANT] > This update changes how refresh tokens are stored and accessed! It is recommended, if you have downloaded v1.0.0-alpha-r1, to install this security patch. ## Improvements - Changed the way PluralCraft saves OAuth refresh tokens from being plain text inside a `.json` file to the operating system's credentials manager (like Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, or Linux Secret Service/GNOME Keyring). ## Requirements - Minecraft Java Edition 26.3 - **Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer** - Fabric API 0.166.2+26.3 - Java 25 or newer Install the matching Fabric API JAR and the PluralCraft JAR in the `mods` folder on the server and client. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Foreverably/PluralCraft/compare/1.0.0-alpha-r1...1.0.0-alpha-r2

releases.notes:
Version: v1.0.0-alpha-r1
A Minecraft mod made with DID/OSDD systems in mind. • Website • Support Discord

## Features - Link your PluralBuddy system using `/pluralcraft link` - Unlink through `/pluralcraft unlink` - Automatically apply alter, latch, and off auto-proxy modes - Supports per-alter proxy prefixes and suffixes - Displays the fronting alter in Minecraft chat - View alters, proxy tags, and auto-proxy settings ## Commands - `/pluralcraft link` Link to PluralBuddy - `/pluralcraft status` View the linked system and active alter - `/pluralcraft alters` List alters and proxy tags - `/pluralcraft ap` View auto-proxy settings - `/pluralcraft refresh` Refresh linked data - `/pluralcraft unlink` Clear the PluralBuddy link ## Requirements - Minecraft Java Edition 26.3 - **Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer** - Fabric API 0.166.2+26.3 - Java 25 or newer Install the matching Fabric API JAR and the PluralCraft JAR in the `mods` folder on the server and client. ## Privacy PluralCraft stores OAuth tokens, system information, alters, proxy tags, and auto-proxy data in `config/pluralcraft/link.json`. Protect the Minecraft profile directory and use `/pluralcraft unlink` to remove the saved link.
